schema: FLINT mechanism contract v1: for each name hooked in Assign_Mechanism, the species slots (name + elemental composition) and the reaction counts per table type that the compiled routine expects; utils/mechanism_contract.py turns it into src/lib/Lib_Chemistry_contract.f90; for a generated routine also its reaction structure ('fingerprint': rate table, concentration factors, third body and efficiencies, omegadot rows per reaction; checked against the sources by utils/mechanism_contract.py --check)
origin: species slots, reaction counts and flags transcribed from the routines of src/lib/Lib_ChemMech (Singh slots from singh.f90:15-16); the fingerprints of the generated routines are computed from their sources by utils/mechanism_contract.py --fingerprints
